title: Fix: the string builder that overflows
hints: Lots of short appends work; one long append doesn't. Take an empty builder and append a 40-character string: what capacity does the code pick, and how many bytes does it then copy?

When the text doesn't fit, the capacity is doubled **once** (or set to 16 from empty). Nothing checks that the new capacity is actually big enough for `len + n + 1` bytes, so a long append still writes past the end of the block.
After computing `new_cap`, keep doubling until it fits: `while (new_cap < sb->len + n + 1) new_cap *= 2;`
